messages:
maria: quick design review after the alpha calls. two main complaints: token meter hover is confusing and the stop button is getting accidentally tapped on narrow windows. jotting notes here. kevin: can you share screenshots or repro steps for the hitbox issue? maria: yeah, screenshots attached in the thread (see drive link). basically in 1024x768 the token meter overlaps the stop icon by ~8px. users try to hit stop and hit the meter. sam: noted. dev side: the meter is absolutely positioned but when we animate it in on stream we change transform which expands bounding box briefly. that causes the overlap. cheaper fix: reduce meter hit area and add pointer-events: none on the non-interactive parts. ali: usability POV: some users expect stop to be near the text input. maybe we should move stop to the left of the message actions, make it a larger target, and move regenerate into the kebab menu. regen is less frequent and can be tucked away. olga: accessibility: hover-only disclosure is a problem. Hovercard must be keyboard-focusable (tab), and we need role=tooltip or role=dialog with aria-describedby. streaming updates for token counts need an aria-live region so screen readers get notified. also ensure focus order doesn't jump during overlay. kevin: proposal: 1) hovercard shows a concise breakdown: "Prompt: 48 • Context: 320 • Session: 368 (approx.)" and a small CSV/export icon to send current prompt to the library. 2) Stop stays visible and becomes a larger 40-44px icon button with aria-label="Stop output". 3) Regenerate goes into kebab menu. maria: microcopy: prefer "Stop output" instead of "Stop generation" — shorter and matches alpha notes. For hovercard header: "Estimated tokens (approx.)" seems ok. sam: impl note: making stop larger will shift layout if we don't reserve space. I'll reserve a 48px slot in the message actions so adding size doesn't reflow. For the hovercard we can render it in a portal to avoid reflow; but that needs keyboard-focus handling to emulate a tabindex target. ali: mobile: hovercard should degrade to tap-to-open panel. stop must be 44px min for touch. Also add a long-press hint to copy tokens for power users. olga: CSS + html examples: ```css @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .streaming-spinner { animation: none !important; } } ``` ```html
Streaming 120 tokens (est)
``` kevin: keyboard shortcut: Esc to stop output when the chat pane has focus. we'll surface that in a tooltip and the keyboard shortcuts help modal. maria: telemetry showed ~42% of stop clicks misclick on the meter in the narrow viewport. we should A/B test spacing vs moving regen to kebab. sam: perf: avoiding layout shifts improves frame rate during streaming by ~12% in our local tests. I'll prototype portal hovercard + reserved slot and run perf harness with 1k token streams. kevin: i'll do mocks for the 3 states: default (collapsed), hovering/focused, mobile tap panel. will include the export icon and the short token breakdown. ali: i'll draft copy for the export flow to prompt library and the microcopy for the stop button and tooltip. olga: i'll run keyboard walkthrough and gather a11y checklist items, then share a short PR with aria attributes. deploy-bot: playground v2 staging deployed (sha: 4b5c9) :rocket: maria: plan: kevin mock + sam prototype + ali copy + olga a11y check. quick 3-user usability test next week. tagging owners for follow-up. :thumbsup:
